response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrated C++ experience on Windows in capital markets or fixed-income domains, with most recent work in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang across non-financial domains; while there is brief C++ exposure from 2014–2015 at National Instruments, it is outdated and not tied to financial systems, and there is no evidence of SQL Server/Oracle or domain expertise in fixed income or investment banking.
strengths: Strong full-stack and polyglot development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical workshops
Experience with CI/CD, Docker, and DevOps infrastructure
concerns: No recent or relevant C++ experience on Windows in financial systems
Lacks demonstrable fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge
SQL experience is listed but not contextualized in enterprise financial databases like SQL Server or Oracle
